text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The term exams are fast approaching.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. How about you, Air Groove? Are your 
studies going well?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The student council seems as busy as ever, 
and it looked like you were even patiently 
helping the underclassmen with their 
homework yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Teaching others serves as great review for 
myself too. I leave nothing to chance.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see! As expected. That's a relief to 
hear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Relieved? ...Hmph. And what about you, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry! I think I've got things 
well in hand.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm declaring it right here. 
I'm going to beat you on the next test.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, a declaration of victory, is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you've said that before, you've 
hardly ever been wrong.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, I have no intention of losing 
either.
